summary: The diff implements a complete redesign of the frontend as 'Verdant Studio', a creative agency site with a forest green, cream, charcoal, and gold palette, editorial typography (Cormorant Garamond, Outfit, DM Mono), and multiple new sections. REQ-1 and REQ-2 are well satisfied. REQ-3 has a concern: the backend/main.mo is not a minimal empty actor — it imports and includes a MixinStorage mixin, which adds backend functionality beyond what was requested.

hallucinated_features.description: The backend/main.mo includes a MixinStorage import and mixin ('import MixinStorage "blob-storage/Mixin"; actor { include MixinStorage(); };'), adding blob storage functionality to the backend actor rather than keeping it as a minimal empty actor.
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-3 explicitly requires the backend Motoko actor to remain as a minimal empty actor with no new backend endpoints or data models added. The MixinStorage inclusion was not requested.
